arm_definitions.ablation_no_binding: Uses declared guard position but ignores request/resource binding.
arm_definitions.ablation_no_cross_review_abstention: Accepts the single LLM arm without cross-check or abstention; equals LLM-only.
arm_definitions.ablation_no_ordering_dominance: Uses binding only and ignores whether DENY dominates commit.
arm_definitions.ablation_no_probe: LLM hypothesis without deterministic static verification; equals LLM-only by construction.
arm_definitions.clawaudit_style_adapted: Same-file syntactic guard/effect ordering only; unknown otherwise.
arm_definitions.full_cross_validated: Decides only when frozen static and LLM arms agree.

claim_boundary: Held-out owned-program comparison on a shared denominator and evidence budget. The unavailable real-contract comparison is reported as not estimable, not zero.
